events.description: 3. ORDER (Directing Briefing) that the Court hereby DIRECTS Defendant Lackey to file a notice with the Court outlining the steps that it has taken to notify Plaintiff, the National Democratic Policy Committee or its successor, as well as his co-Defendants, Kevin Pearl and Robert Robinson, of the instant litigation. Moreover, given that an attorney of record exists for the National Democratic Policy Committee - Mr. Gerald Zerkin - the Court likewise DIRECTS Mr. Zerkin to file his position on (1) whether he intends to represent the National Democratic Policy Committee in this matter and, if not, (2) what steps he has taken to inform any successor organization to the National Democratic Policy Committee of the instant litigation. The parties shall file their respective positions not later than August 29, 2024. Moreover, this Order hereby constitutes notice to any interested party with a stake in this litigation of the instant Motion to Vacate. Any interested party is DIRECTED to file their position on Defendant Lackey's Motion to Vacate not later than September 12, 2024. It is so ORDERED. Signed by District Judge David J. Novak on 8/15/2024. (jenjones, ) (Entered: 08/15/2024)

events.description: 6. MEMORANDUM ORDER (Granting Motion to Vacate Consent Decree) that the Court hereby GRANTS Defendant's Motion to Vacate the Consent Decree (ECF No. 1 ). Accordingly, the Court hereby VACATES the Consent Decree and DISSOLVES any injunctive relief previously granted. SEE ORDER FOR DETAILS. This case is now CLOSED. It is so ORDERED. Signed by District Judge David J. Novak on 10/2/2024. (jenjones, ) (Entered: 10/02/2024)
